name: Discovery (STS-103)
about: Discovery (STS-103) (1999-069A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 1999 Dec 20. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1999 Dec 21), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
